tools.name: count_homes
tools.description: How many households in a service area fit a contractor's trade, judged from property signals (tree canopy, slope, lot size, pool) rather than just addresses. Free, no key needed. Returns the count, the price to buy, and a link where the user can buy the list in one step.

tools.name: preview_market
tools.description: The measured count for a trade and area, plus every strategy card the trade offers (id, name, whether it is the widest) so the user can narrow by sending strategyIds, and which property signals are measured there. Needs a Meadley Bros. API key. Members create keys in Profile and billing under Advanc

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Start buying a mailing list of the matching homes: owner names and mailing addresses delivered as an Excel file plus a CSV.
